Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The phrase repeats the time meaning because 古代 already names a time period. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别的人 distinguishes people from a previously mentioned person or group, but no such comparison has been established here; 别人 means other people in general. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：不管得什么病的人吃了这种植物都会觉得身体更好，什么病人 does not by itself mean “any patient” in this structure; 不管……的人 clearly expresses that all kinds of patients are included. [rule: none]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，Plants use a matching measure word such as 株 when referring to one individual plant; 个 is too general here. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 有植物的地方：有这种植物的地方，This refers back to the plant just mentioned, so a demonstrative noun phrase makes the connection specific and clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去，找到：神农走了三个月，才找到了，A completed duration takes 了 after the verb, and the completed result of finding also takes 了; 才 shows that the finding happened only after the long journey. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
别的人 is not appropriate here under the teacher's 别人/别的 rule, and 别人 is a correct replacement.
The original needs a completed-action expression after 吃, and the proposed rewrite is grammatical and expresses the intended meaning.
个 is not the appropriate measure word for an individual plant here, while 株 is correct.
有植物的地方 is understandable and adequately refers to the recently mentioned plant, although 有这种植物的地方 is also clearer.
走了三个月 correctly marks the completed duration, and 才找到了 gives a grammatical completed result after the journey.
